query: (Cathay MD) Build a model to organise/optimise routes and service so Overall Rating > 7.

per_column.name: cabin_crew_attitude
per_column.rationale: A qualitative service dimension (warm/proactive vs rude/dismissive) that describes an aspect of the flight experience rather than the overall verdict. It lies outside the focus, is actionable for the airline, and plausibly carries strong signal about whether a reviewer rates the flight >7. Some circularity exists because it is text-derived and contemporaneous with the rating, but it is not a deterministic function of the outcome.

per_column.name: food_quality_rating
per_column.rationale: Aspect-level food assessment with granular failure modes (poor_taste, poor_quantity, special_meal_failure). Predictive of overall satisfaction and outside the focus. Note it partly duplicates the existing numeric 'Food & Beverages' column, so its incremental leverage is limited, but the failure-mode granularity adds some signal.

per_column.name: seat_comfort_issue
per_column.rationale: Categorical seat-comfort failure modes (narrow_cramped, broken_defective, etc.) describing an experiential driver of satisfaction, distinct from and not a function of the overall rating. Overlaps with the existing numeric 'Seat Comfort' column, so incremental value is modest, but still a legitimate predictor.

per_column.name: disruption_handling_quality
per_column.rationale: Whether a disruption occurred and how well it was handled is a strong, actionable driver of satisfaction that is NOT captured by any original column. It lies outside the focus and plausibly carries substantial predictive signal — a genuinely valuable added feature.

per_column.name: class_product_value_gap
per_column.rationale: Categories like exceeded/meets/significant_shortfall vs class expectations are themselves an overall evaluative satisfaction judgment, essentially re-expressing the reviewer's global verdict rather than an independent operational driver. It is nearly collinear with / a restatement of the overall rating, so it contributes little independent predictive leverage.

per_column.name: special_service_handling
per_column.rationale: How special requests/assistance were handled (ignored_refused, well_handled) is an operational service dimension not present in the original columns. Mostly 'not_applicable' limits its coverage, but for the affected subset it is a legitimate, actionable predictor outside the focus.

per_column.name: route_haul_type
per_column.rationale: Objective flight attribute (short/medium/long haul) derived from Route. Fully independent of the rating, directly relevant to the 'optimise routes' objective, and plausibly associated with satisfaction patterns. A clean, non-circular predictor.

judge.rationale: As a set these are mostly legitimate, actionable predictors of overall_rating_gt7. The strongest incremental leverage comes from disruption_handling_quality, special_service_handling, and route_haul_type, none of which are captured by the original columns; route_haul_type is also fully objective and non-circular. The qualitative crew/food/seat features carry signal but overlap with existing numeric sub-ratings, reducing incremental value, and being text-derived they share some circularity with the rating (though not strict leakage). class_product_value_gap is an evaluative expectation-gap judgment that largely restates the overall satisfaction verdict and adds little independent signal. Net: solid but not exceptional predictive leverage beyond the original columns.
